reason: In pkg/services/authz/rbac/service.go:123-136, Check returns immediately when the cached permCache map allows, but when that same cached map does not allow it falls through to getIdentityPermissions at :139, which always queries the DB (:380-406). A revoked grant therefore stays honoured until the permCache entry expires (shortCacheTTL, 30s, :32); the patch adds this asymmetry, though the 30s stale-grant window already existed because the old getUserPermissions returned any cache hit.
